(* SUBSYSTEM 2: SOGI-PLL & POSITIVE/NEGATIVE SEQUENCE VOLTAGE/CURRENT EXTRACTION                         *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 2.1 Clarke Transformation: Convert 3-Phase Instantaneous (abc) to Stationary Frame (alpha/beta/zero) *)
rV_Alpha := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (rV_Grid_L1_kV - 0.5 * rV_Grid_L2_kV - 0.5 * rV_Grid_L3_kV);
rV_Beta  := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (SQRT_3 * 0.5 * rV_Grid_L2_kV - SQRT_3 * 0.5 * rV_Grid_L3_kV);
rV_Zero  := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (INV_SQRT_3 * (rV_Grid_L1_kV + rV_Grid_L2_kV + rV_Grid_L3_kV));

rI_Alpha := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (rI_Grid_L1_kA - 0.5 * rI_Grid_L2_kA - 0.5 * rI_Grid_L3_kA);
rI_Beta  := SQRT_2_OVER_3 * (SQRT_3 * 0.5 * rI_Grid_L2_kA - SQRT_3 * 0.5 * rI_Grid_L3_kA);

(* 2.2 Discrete SOGI (Second-Order Generalized Integrator) for Phase A In-Phase & Quadrature Generation *)
(* Trapezoidal Numerical Integration Formulation *)
rTemp_Val1 := rV_Alpha - rSOGI_v_prime;
rTemp_Val2 := rSOGI_Gain_k * rTemp_Val1 - rSOGI_qv_prime;

rSOGI_v_prime  := rSOGI_v_prime_prev + (rDt_Seconds * rSOGI_Omega_Grid * rTemp_Val2);
rSOGI_qv_prime := rSOGI_qv_prime_prev + (rDt_Seconds * rSOGI_Omega_Grid * rSOGI_v_prime);

rSOGI_v_prime_prev  := rSOGI_v_prime;
rSOGI_qv_prime_prev := rSOGI_qv_prime;

(* 2.3 Instantaneous Symmetrical Component Decomposition in Alpha-Beta Frame *)
rV_Alpha_Pos := 0.5 * (rV_Alpha - rSOGI_qv_prime);
rV_Beta_Pos  := 0.5 * (rV_Beta + rSOGI_v_prime);

rV_Alpha_Neg := 0.5 * (rV_Alpha + rSOGI_qv_prime);
rV_Beta_Neg  := 0.5 * (rV_Beta - rSOGI_v_prime);

(* 2.4 Park Transformation to Synchronous Rotating Frame (d-q Pos and Neg) *)
rV_d_Pos :=  rV_Alpha_Pos * COS(rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rV_Beta_Pos * SIN(rSOGI_Phase_Angle);
rV_q_Pos := -rV_Alpha_Pos * SIN(rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rV_Beta_Pos * COS(rSOGI_Phase_Angle);

rV_d_Neg :=  rV_Alpha_Neg * COS(-rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rV_Beta_Neg * SIN(-rSOGI_Phase_Angle);
rV_q_Neg := -rV_Alpha_Neg * SIN(-rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rV_Beta_Neg * COS(-rSOGI_Phase_Angle);

rI_d_Pos :=  rI_Alpha * COS(rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rI_Beta * SIN(rSOGI_Phase_Angle);
rI_q_Pos := -rI_Alpha * SIN(rSOGI_Phase_Angle) + rI_Beta * COS(rSOGI_Phase_Angle);

(* 2.5 Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) Loop Filter Updates *)
rPLL_Integ_State := rPLL_Integ_State + (rPLL_Integ_Gain * rV_q_Pos * rDt_Seconds);
(* Anti-Windup Clamping on Grid Frequency (45 Hz to 65 Hz) *)
IF rPLL_Integ_State < (TWO_PI * 45.0) THEN
    rPLL_Integ_State := TWO_PI * 45.0;
ELSIF rPLL_Integ_State > (TWO_PI * 65.0) THEN
    rPLL_Integ_State := TWO_PI * 65.0;
END_IF;

rSOGI_Omega_Grid := rPLL_Integ_State + (rPLL_Prop_Gain * rV_q_Pos);
rSOGI_Phase_Angle := rSOGI_Phase_Angle + (rSOGI_Omega_Grid * rDt_Seconds);

(* Modulo 2*PI Wrap Around *)
WHILE rSOGI_Phase_Angle >= TWO_PI DO
    rSOGI_Phase_Angle := rSOGI_Phase_Angle - TWO_PI;
END_WHILE;
WHILE rSOGI_Phase_Angle < 0.0 DO
    rSOGI_Phase_Angle := rSOGI_Phase_Angle + TWO_PI;
END_WHILE;

(* 2.6 Compute Symmetrical Component Per-Unit Magnitudes *)
rV_Pos_Magnitude_kV := SQRT(rV_d_Pos * rV_d_Pos + rV_q_Pos * rV_q_Pos);
rV_Neg_Magnitude_kV := SQRT(rV_d_Neg * rV_d_Neg + rV_q_Neg * rV_q_Neg);

rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu := rV_Pos_Magnitude_kV / rV_Base_L_N_Peak_kV;
rV_Grid_Negative_Seq_pu := rV_Neg_Magnitude_kV / rV_Base_L_N_Peak_kV;

(* 2.7 Substation Grid Instantaneous Delivered Active and Reactive Power *)
rP_Delivered_MW   := 1.5 * (rV_d_Pos * rI_d_Pos + rV_q_Pos * rI_q_Pos);
rQ_Delivered_MVAR := 1.5 * (rV_q_Pos * rI_d_Pos - rV_d_Pos * rI_q_Pos);

    rThermal_Derating_Factor := 0.0;
ELSE
    rTemp_Val1 := rT_Coil_Voted_K / T_CRITICAL_ZERO_K;
    rThermal_Derating_Factor := EXPT(MAX(0.0, 1.0 - EXPT(rTemp_Val1, 1.70)), 1.50);
END_IF;

(* Magnetic Field Degradation Term (Kim-Anderson Model) *)
rB_Field_Derating_Factor := EXPT(1.0 + (rSelf_Magnetic_Field_T / 18.50), -0.85);

(* Mechanical Strain Degradation Factor (Parabolic Ekin Scaling) *)
IF rEffective_Strain_uE <= STRAIN_REVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE THEN
    rStrain_Derating_Factor := 1.00;
ELSIF rEffective_Strain_uE <= STRAIN_IRREVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE THEN
    rTemp_Val2 := (rEffective_Strain_uE - STRAIN_REVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE) / 1000.0;
    rStrain_Derating_Factor := MAX(0.0, 1.0 - (0.185 * rTemp_Val2 * rTemp_Val2));
ELSE
    (* Irreversible Delamination Plastic Rupture Zone *)
    rStrain_Derating_Factor := 0.05;
END_IF;

(* Total Computed Real-Time Critical Current *)
rCritical_Current_Est_kA := I_CRITICAL_ZERO_KA * rThermal_Derating_Factor *
                            rB_Field_Derating_Factor * rStrain_Derating_Factor;

(* Instantaneous Operating Safety Margin to Critical Current *)
rCritical_Current_Margin_kA := rCritical_Current_Est_kA - rI_Mag_Voted_kA;

(* 3.4 Magneto-Mechanical Stress Accumulators *)
(* Lorentz Force Density F_L = J x B [MN/m^3] *)
rLorentz_Force_Density_MN_m3 := (rI_Mag_Voted_kA / 0.0012) * rSelf_Magnetic_Field_T;
rTotal_Hoop_Stress_MPa := rEffective_Strain_uE * 0.165; (* Young Modulus for Hastelloy C-276 Substrate: 165 GPa *)

(* 3.5 Mechanical Strain Safety Interlocks & Tripping *)
IF rEffective_Strain_uE >= STRAIN_IRREVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE THEN
    bTape_Strain_Overlimit_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarm_Critical_Trips := dwAlarm_Critical_Trips OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Plastic Strain Fracture Trip *)
ELSIF rEffective_Strain_uE >= (STRAIN_REVERSIBLE_LIMIT_UE * 0.90) THEN
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00001000; (* Bit 12: Strain Near Reversible Limit Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rCritical_Current_Margin_kA <= 0.400 THEN (* Less than 400A margin to quench *)
    dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00002000; (* Bit 13: Critical Current Margin Depleted *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SUBSYSTEM 4: SAVITZKY-GOLAY NUMERICAL DIFFERENTIATOR & RESISTIVE QUENCH DETECTION                   *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 4.1 Update Circular History Buffer for 5-Point Numerical Differentiation *)
aI_Hist_Buffer[4] := aI_Hist_Buffer[3];
aI_Hist_Buffer[3] := aI_Hist_Buffer[2];
aI_Hist_Buffer[2] := aI_Hist_Buffer[1];
aI_Hist_Buffer[1] := aI_Hist_Buffer[0];
aI_Hist_Buffer[0] := rI_Mag_Voted_kA;

(* 4.2 5-Point Savitzky-Golay Filtered Numerical Derivative (di/dt) *)
(* Formula: di/dt = (-2*I[k-2] - I[k-1] + I[k+1] + 2*I[k+2]) / (10 * dt) *)
rDi_Dt_Filtered_kA_s := (
    -2.0 * aI_Hist_Buffer[4]
    - 1.0 * aI_Hist_Buffer[3]
    + 1.0 * aI_Hist_Buffer[1]
    + 2.0 * aI_Hist_Buffer[0]
) / (10.0 * rDt_Seconds);

(* 4.3 Mutual Inductive Voltage Compensation *)
(* Total Magnet Terminal Voltage v_term = L*(di/dt) + v_resistive *)
rV_Inductive_Theoretical_kV := L_COIL_HENRIES * rDi_Dt_Filtered_kA_s;

(* Compute Pure Compensated Resistive Voltage Drop (kV to V conversion) *)
(* Incorporates Hardware Rogowski Co-Wound Loop Voltage rV_Pickup_Compensation_V *)
rV_Resistive_Quench_V := ABS((rV_Magnet_Terminal_kV - rV_Inductive_Theoretical_kV) * 1000.0) - ABS(rV_Pickup_Compensation_V);

IF rV_Resistive_Quench_V < 0.0 THEN
    rV_Resistive_Quench_V := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 4.4 Multi-Tap Threshold & Time Integration *)
IF rV_Resistive_Quench_V >= V_RESISTIVE_QUENCH_THRESH_V THEN
    nQuench_Persistence_Ticks := nQuench_Persistence_Ticks + 1;
    rQuench_Integral_VoltSec := rQuench_Integral_VoltSec + (rV_Resistive_Quench_V * rDt_Seconds);
ELSE
    IF nQuench_Persistence_Ticks > 0 THEN
        nQuench_Persistence_Ticks := nQuench_Persistence_Ticks - 1;
    END_IF;
    rQuench_Integral_VoltSec := MAX(0.0, rQuench_Integral_VoltSec - (0.010 * rDt_Seconds));
END_IF;

(* 4.5 Hotspot Adiabatic Action Integral MIITs Accumulator *)
(* Action Integral: Integral of I^2(t) dt in [MA^2 * s] *)
rAction_Integral_MIITs := rAction_Integral_MIITs + (
    (rI_Mag_Voted_kA * rI_Mag_Voted_kA) * (rDt_Seconds * 0.0010)
);

(* Non-Linear Adiabatic Hotspot Temperature Estimation for REBCO/Copper Matrix *)
IF rAction_Integral_MIITs > 0.0001 THEN
    (* Semi-Empirical Polynomial Correlation: T_hotspot = T_0 + c1*U + c2*U^2 *)
    rHotspot_Adiabatic_Temp_K := T_OPERATING_NOMINAL_K +
                                 (84.50 * rAction_Integral_MIITs) +
                                 (12.30 * rAction_Integral_MIITs * rAction_Integral_MIITs);
ELSE
    rHotspot_Adiabatic_Temp_K := rT_Coil_Voted_K;
END_IF;
rHotspot_Estimated_Temp_K := rHotspot_Adiabatic_Temp_K;

(* 4.6 Quench Trip Criteria Evaluation *)
(* Trigger Criterion 1: Continuous Resistive Voltage > 50 mV for > 5 ticks (1.0 ms) *)
(* Trigger Criterion 2: Integrated Resistive Energy > 0.00025 V*s *)
(* Trigger Criterion 3: Estimated Hotspot Core Temperature Exceeds 85 Kelvin *)
IF (nQuench_Persistence_Ticks >= 5) OR
   (rQuench_Integral_VoltSec >= 0.000250) OR
   (rHotspot_Adiabatic_Temp_K >= 85.0) THEN
    bQuench_Detected_Imminent := TRUE;
    dwAlarm_Critical_Trips := dwAlarm_Critical_Trips OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Quench Detected *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SUBSYSTEM 5: LUENBERGER STATE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) ENGINE                       *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* 5.1 Measurement Assignment & Residual Innovation Calculation *)
(* State Vector: x[1]=i_d, x[2]=i_q, x[3]=v_dc, x[4]=i_mag *)
aObserver_Residual[1] := rI_d_Pos - aState_x_est[1];
aObserver_Residual[2] := rI_q_Pos - aState_x_est[2];
aObserver_Residual[3] := rV_DCLink_kV - aState_x_est[3];
aObserver_Residual[4] := rI_Mag_Voted_kA - aState_x_est[4];

(* Update State Estimate with Observer Innovation Correction: x_hat = x_pred + L * residual *)
FOR iIndex_i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rScratch_Sum := 0.0;
    FOR iIndex_j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rScratch_Sum := rScratch_Sum + (aMatrix_L_Obs_Gain[iIndex_i, iIndex_j] * aObserver_Residual[iIndex_j]);
    END_FOR;
    aState_x_est[iIndex_i] := aState_x_pred[iIndex_i] + rScratch_Sum;
END_FOR;

(* 5.2 Disturbance Vector Assignment *)
aDisturbance_d[1] := rV_d_Pos;
aDisturbance_d[2] := rV_q_Pos;

(* 5.3 Reference Trajectory Target Generation Based on Active Operating Mode *)
IF iState = STATE_FOUR_QUADRANT_COMP_ACTIVE THEN
    (* Active Sag Compensation: Inject High Active & Reactive Current *)
    aState_x_ref[1] := (rP_Comp_Target_MW / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[2] := -(rQ_Comp_Target_MVAR / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[3] := V_DCLINK_NOMINAL_KV;
    aState_x_ref[4] := rI_Mag_Voted_kA; (* Floating Magnet Reference during Compensation *)

ELSIF iState = STATE_MAGNET_RAMP_CHARGING THEN
    (* Charging Mode: Regulate DC Bus & Constant Inductive Ramp Current *)
    aState_x_ref[1] := 0.0;
    aState_x_ref[2] := 0.0;
    aState_x_ref[3] := V_DCLINK_NOMINAL_KV;
    aState_x_ref[4] := I_MAGNET_RATED_KA;

ELSIF iState = STATE_CONTROLLED_MAGNET_DISCH THEN
    (* Orderly Discharge Mode *)
    aState_x_ref[1] := -(rP_Dispatch_Ref_MW / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[2] := 0.0;
    aState_x_ref[3] := V_DCLINK_NOMINAL_KV;
    aState_x_ref[4] := 0.050; (* Target Zero Current *)

ELSE
    (* Standby / Persistent / Idle Tracking *)
    aState_x_ref[1] := (rP_Dispatch_Ref_MW / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[2] := -(rQ_Dispatch_Ref_MVAR / 1.5) / MAX(10.0, rV_d_Pos);
    aState_x_ref[3] := V_DCLINK_NOMINAL_KV;
    aState_x_ref[4] := rI_Mag_Voted_kA;
END_IF;

(* 5.4 Explicit Quadratic MPC Law Evaluation: u = -K_mpc * (x_est - x_ref) - K_dist * d *)
FOR iIndex_i := 1 TO 3 DO
    rScratch_Sum := 0.0;
    (* State Feedback Term *)
    FOR iIndex_j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rScratch_Sum := rScratch_Sum - (
            aMatrix_K_MPC_Gain[iIndex_i, iIndex_j] * (aState_x_est[iIndex_j] - aState_x_ref[iIndex_j])
        );
    END_FOR;
    (* Disturbance Feedforward Rejection Term *)
    FOR iIndex_j := 1 TO 2 DO
        rScratch_Sum := rScratch_Sum - (
            aMatrix_K_Dist_Gain[iIndex_i, iIndex_j] * aDisturbance_d[iIndex_j]
        );
    END_FOR;
    aControl_u[iIndex_i] := rScratch_Sum;
END_FOR;

(* 5.5 Polyhedral Constraints & Actuator Anti-Windup Clamping *)
(* Inverter Space-Vector Modulation Vectors m_d, m_q Clamping to Over-Modulation Boundary *)
rTemp_Val1 := SQRT(aControl_u[1] * aControl_u[1] + aControl_u[2] * aControl_u[2]);
IF rTemp_Val1 > 1.1547 THEN (* 2 / sqrt(3) Inverter Linear Over-Modulation Limit *)
    aControl_u[1] := (aControl_u[1] / rTemp_Val1) * 1.1547;
    aControl_u[2] := (aControl_u[2] / rTemp_Val1) * 1.1547;
END_IF;

(* Two-Quadrant Chopper Duty Cycle Clamping [-1.0..+1.0] *)
(* +1.0 = Maximum Magnet Discharge (Energy into DC Link), -1.0 = Maximum Magnet Charging *)
IF aControl_u[3] > 0.980 THEN
    aControl_u[3] := 0.980;
ELSIF aControl_u[3] < -0.980 THEN
    aControl_u[3] := -0.980;
END_IF;

(* Slew-Rate Limiting on Chopper Command to Prevent Excessive dI/dt Mechanical Stress *)
IF (aControl_u[3] - aControl_u_prev[3]) > (25.0 * rDt_Seconds) THEN
    aControl_u[3] := aControl_u_prev[3] + (25.0 * rDt_Seconds);
ELSIF (aControl_u[3] - aControl_u_prev[3]) < (-25.0 * rDt_Seconds) THEN
    aControl_u[3] := aControl_u_prev[3] - (25.0 * rDt_Seconds);
END_IF;
aControl_u_prev[3] := aControl_u[3];

(* Assign Control Outputs *)
rPWM_Modulation_d         := aControl_u[1];
rPWM_Modulation_q         := aControl_u[2];
rChopper_Modulation_Index := aControl_u[3];

(* 5.6 Discrete One-Step Ahead State Prediction: x_next = A*x_est + B*u + E*d *)
FOR iIndex_i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rScratch_Sum := 0.0;
    FOR iIndex_j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rScratch_Sum := rScratch_Sum + (aMatrix_A_Sys[iIndex_i, iIndex_j] * aState_x_est[iIndex_j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iIndex_j := 1 TO 3 DO
        rScratch_Sum := rScratch_Sum + (aMatrix_B_Sys[iIndex_i, iIndex_j] * aControl_u[iIndex_j]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iIndex_j := 1 TO 2 DO
        rScratch_Sum := rScratch_Sum + (aMatrix_E_Dist[iIndex_i, iIndex_j] * aDisturbance_d[iIndex_j]);
    END_FOR;
    aState_x_pred[iIndex_i] := rScratch_Sum;
END_FOR;

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SUBSYSTEM 6: PERSISTENT CURRENT SWITCH (PCS) THERMAL-ELECTRIC INTERLOCK ENGINE                      *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Verify Zero-Current Commutation Condition Across Converter & Superconducting Loop *)
(* ZCS Condition: The external chopper bridge must support current equal to magnet current to avoid arc *)
bPCS_Zero_Current_Commutated := ABS(rI_Magnet_Sens1_kA - rI_Mag_Voted_kA) < 0.010;

(* Thermal Diffusion Modeling for Non-Inductive Manganin Switch Heater *)
CASE iPCS_Transition_Phase OF
    0: (* SUPERCONDUCTING CLOSED STATE: Heater OFF, Zero Resistance *)
        rPCS_Heater_Duty := 0.0;
        bPCS_Persistent_State_Active := TRUE;
        rPCS_Shunt_Resistance_Ohm := 0.0;
        rPCS_Thermal_Soak_Timer_s := 0.0;

    1: (* HEATING TRANSITION: Activating Solid-State Heater *)
        IF bPCS_Heater_Pwr_Feedback THEN
            rPCS_Heater_Duty := 1.0;
            bPCS_Persistent_State_Active := FALSE;
            rPCS_Thermal_Soak_Timer_s := rPCS_Thermal_Soak_Timer_s + rDt_Seconds;
            IF (rT_PCS_Switch_K >= 94.0) AND (rPCS_Thermal_Soak_Timer_s >= 4.50) THEN
                iPCS_Transition_Phase := 2; (* Fully Normal Resistive *)
                rPCS_Thermal_Soak_Timer_s := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rPCS_Heater_Duty := 0.0;
            dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00010000; (* Bit 16: PCS Heater Feedback Missing *)
        END_IF;

    2: (* RESISTIVE OPEN STATE: Normal Conduction (R = 25 Ohms) *)
        rPCS_Heater_Duty := 0.45; (* Holding Power PWM *)
        bPCS_Persistent_State_Active := FALSE;
        rPCS_Shunt_Resistance_Ohm := 25.0;

    3: (* COOLING RE-SUPERCONDUCTING SOAK TRANSITION: Heater OFF, Waiting Cryo Soak *)
        rPCS_Heater_Duty := 0.0;
        rPCS_Thermal_Soak_Timer_s := rPCS_Thermal_Soak_Timer_s + rDt_Seconds;
        IF (rT_PCS_Switch_K <= 4.8) AND (rPCS_Thermal_Soak_Timer_s >= 8.50) THEN
            iPCS_Transition_Phase := 0; (* Returned to Superconducting *)
            bPCS_Persistent_State_Active := TRUE;
            rPCS_Shunt_Resistance_Ohm := 0.0;
            rPCS_Thermal_Soak_Timer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        iPCS_Transition_Phase := 0;
        rPCS_Heater_Duty := 0.0;
END_CASE;

(* Total Usable Stored Inductive Energy Calculation *)
rSMES_Stored_Energy_MJ := 0.50 * L_COIL_HENRIES * (rI_Mag_Voted_kA * rI_Mag_Voted_kA);

(* ==================================================================================================== *)
(* SUBSYSTEM 7: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE) WITH SUB-MS SAG ENGINE                          *)
(* ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Immediate Global Fast Quench Override: Check Safety Loop & Critical Trips *)
IF (NOT bSafety_Loop_Closed) OR (dwAlarm_Critical_Trips <> 16#00000000) THEN
    iState := STATE_CRITICAL_QUENCH_DUMP;
END_IF;

CASE iState OF

    STATE_BOOT_SELF_DIAG: (* State 0: Self-Test & Calibration Verification *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0001;
        bQuench_FastDump_Thyristor_Gate := FALSE;
        bCryo_Vessel_Emergency_Vent_Valve := FALSE;
        rChopper_Modulation_Index := 0.0;
        rPWM_Modulation_d := 0.0;
        rPWM_Modulation_q := 0.0;
        bSubMillisecond_Sag_Active := FALSE;

        IF rState_Dwell_Timer_s >= 2.00 THEN (* 2 Seconds Diagnostics Dwell *)
            IF bSafety_Loop_Closed AND (iI_Mag_Degraded_Mode >= 2) AND (iT_Coil_Degraded_Mode >= 2) THEN
                iState := STATE_CRYO_PRECOOL_VERIFICATION;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    STATE_CRYO_PRECOOL_VERIFICATION: (* State 10: Thermal Soak & Cryogen Verification *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0002;
        IF (rT_Coil_Voted_K <= 4.80) AND
           (rL_Helium_Bath_Level_pct >= 85.0) AND
           (rP_Cryostat_Vessel_bar >= 1.01) AND (rP_Cryostat_Vessel_bar <= 1.25) AND
           (rT_Cryo_Shield_K <= 50.0) THEN

            IF bMaster_Enable_Cmd THEN
                iState := STATE_CONVERTER_PRECHARGE_SYNC;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00020000; (* Bit 17: Cryo Precool Not Ready *)
        END_IF;

    STATE_CONVERTER_PRECHARGE_SYNC: (* State 20: DC Bus Precharge & SOGI-PLL Substation Lock *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0004;
        IF bGrid_Intertie_Breaker_Closed AND
           (rV_DCLink_kV >= (V_DCLINK_NOMINAL_KV * 0.95)) AND
           (rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu >= 0.95) AND (rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu <= 1.05) AND
           (ABS(rV_q_Pos) < 1.50) THEN (* PLL In Lock *)

            iState := STATE_PCS_PRE_RAMP_COMMUTATION;
        END_IF;

    STATE_PCS_PRE_RAMP_COMMUTATION: (* State 30: Open Persistent Switch for Magnet Ramping *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0008;
        IF iPCS_Transition_Phase = 0 THEN
            iPCS_Transition_Phase := 1; (* Initiate Heating Transition *)
        ELSIF iPCS_Transition_Phase = 2 THEN
            (* PCS is fully normal resistive (25 Ohms); Ready for Ramping *)
            iState := STATE_MAGNET_RAMP_CHARGING;
        END_IF;

    STATE_MAGNET_RAMP_CHARGING: (* State 40: Inductive Charging via DC Chopper *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0010;
        (* Model Predictive Control dictates chopper duty cycle *)
        IF rI_Mag_Voted_kA >= (I_MAGNET_RATED_KA * 0.995) THEN
            iState := STATE_PCS_PERSISTENT_CLOSURE;
        END_IF;

    STATE_PCS_PERSISTENT_CLOSURE: (* State 50: Re-cool Persistent Switch to Superconducting *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0020;
        IF iPCS_Transition_Phase = 2 THEN
            iPCS_Transition_Phase := 3; (* Initiate Cryo Soak *)
        ELSIF (iPCS_Transition_Phase = 0) AND bPCS_Persistent_State_Active THEN
            iState := STATE_PERSISTENT_STANDBY;
        END_IF;

    STATE_PERSISTENT_STANDBY: (* State 60: Zero-Loss Inductive Energy Standby Surveillance *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0040;
        bSubMillisecond_Sag_Active := FALSE;
        rGrid_Sag_Duration_ms := 0.0;
        rGrid_Sag_Depth_pct := 0.0;

        (* ULTRA-FAST SUB-MILLISECOND VOLTAGE SAG DETECTION TRIGGER *)
        (* Trigger on Positive-Sequence Dip OR High Negative Sequence Asymmetry *)
        IF (rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu <= SAG_TRIGGER_LEVEL_PU) OR
           (rV_Grid_Negative_Seq_pu >= 0.150) THEN
            bSubMillisecond_Sag_Active := TRUE;
            iState := STATE_SUB_MS_SAG_ENGAGEMENT;
        ELSIF NOT bMaster_Enable_Cmd THEN
            iState := STATE_CONTROLLED_MAGNET_DISCH;
        END_IF;

    STATE_SUB_MS_SAG_ENGAGEMENT: (* State 70: Sub-Millisecond Injection Engagement *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0080;
        bSubMillisecond_Sag_Active := TRUE;

        (* Calculate Depth of Sag *)
        rGrid_Sag_Depth_pct := MAX(0.0, (1.0 - rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu) * 100.0);
        rGrid_Sag_Duration_ms := rGrid_Sag_Duration_ms + rDelta_T_ms;

        (* Immediate Dynamic Power Target Calculation to Restore PCC Voltage *)
        (* Proportional Voltage Sag Boost: P_inj = K_p * (1.0 - V_pos) *)
        rP_Comp_Target_MW := MIN(P_MAX_INJECTION_MW, (1.0 - rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu) * 75.0);
        rQ_Comp_Target_MVAR := MIN(Q_MAX_INJECTION_MVAR, (1.0 - rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu) * 120.0);

        (* Transition to Active Four-Quadrant Stabilization *)
        iState := STATE_FOUR_QUADRANT_COMP_ACTIVE;

    STATE_FOUR_QUADRANT_COMP_ACTIVE: (* State 80: High-Speed Four-Quadrant Compensation *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0100;
        bSubMillisecond_Sag_Active := TRUE;
        rGrid_Sag_Duration_ms := rGrid_Sag_Duration_ms + rDelta_T_ms;
        rGrid_Sag_Depth_pct := MAX(0.0, (1.0 - rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu) * 100.0);

        (* Check for Voltage Restoration: V_pos > 0.94 pu for > 15.0 ms *)
        IF (rV_Grid_Positive_Seq_pu >= 0.940) AND (rV_Grid_Negative_Seq_pu < 0.050) THEN
            IF rState_Dwell_Timer_s >= 0.015 THEN (* 15 ms settling *)
                iState := STATE_CONTROLLED_RECHARGE_RECOV;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rState_Dwell_Timer_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Energy Depletion Protection *)
        IF rI_Mag_Voted_kA <= 0.850 THEN (* Magnet energy exhausted *)
            dwAlarm_Warnings := dwAlarm_Warnings OR 16#00040000; (* Bit 18: SMES Energy Reserve Depleted *)
            iState := STATE_CONTROLLED_RECHARGE_RECOV;
        END_IF;

    STATE_CONTROLLED_RECHARGE_RECOV: (* State 90: Smooth Energy Replenishment & Grid Settling *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0200;
        bSubMillisecond_Sag_Active := FALSE;

        (* Smooth Controlled Recharge of SMES Magnet *)
        IF rI_Mag_Voted_kA < I_MAGNET_RATED_KA THEN
            rP_Comp_Target_MW := -rRecharge_Ramp_Rate_MW_s; (* Absorb from grid to recharge *)
            rQ_Comp_Target_MVAR := 0.0;
        ELSE
            rP_Comp_Target_MW := 0.0;
            rQ_Comp_Target_MVAR := 0.0;
            iState := STATE_PERSISTENT_STANDBY;
        END_IF;

    STATE_CONTROLLED_MAGNET_DISCH: (* State 95: Orderly Planned De-Energization *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0400;
        IF rI_Mag_Voted_kA <= 0.050 THEN (* Less than 50 Amperes remaining *)
            iState := STATE_BOOT_SELF_DIAG;
        END_IF;

    STATE_CRITICAL_QUENCH_DUMP: (* State 99: Pyrotechnic Crowbar Trigger & Cryo Vent *)
        wStatus_Word := wStatus_Word OR 16#0800;
        (* Fire Ultra-Fast Pyrotechnic Solid-State Dump Thyristor into 2.5 Ohm Dump Resistor *)
        bQuench_FastDump_Thyristor_Gate := TRUE;

        (* Inhibit Inverter and Chopper PWM Switching Instantly *)
        rChopper_Modulation_Index := 0.0;
        rPWM_Modulation_d := 0.0;
        rPWM_Modulation_q := 0.0;
        bSubMillisecond_Sag_Active := FALSE;

        (* Open Emergency Cryostat Relief Solenoid if Pressure or Boil-Off Elevates *)
        IF (rP_Cryostat_Vessel_bar >= 1.45) OR (rT_Coil_Voted_K >= 25.0) THEN
            bCryo_Vessel_Emergency_Vent_Valve := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        (* Latch State 99 until Operator Reset Pushbutton is Pressed with Cleared Alarms *)
        IF bEmergency_Quench_Ack_Reset AND (rI_Mag_Voted_kA <= 0.020) THEN
            IF bSafety_Loop_Closed THEN
                dwAlarm_Critical_Trips := 16#00000000;
                bQuench_Detected_Imminent := FALSE;
